summary: Private installer upgrade stuck at migrations (Helix Health) — control plane reports 'running migrations' > 60m
description:
## Issue summary
Helix Health (Private) attempted an in-place upgrade of the Redwood Private control plane using the Private installer. Upgrade appears to hang during the "migrations" step. Installer UI/CLI reports "running migrations" continuously (>60 minutes) with no visible progress. Customer is blocked from completing the upgrade window.

## Impact
- Customer cannot complete planned upgrade during maintenance window.
- Risk: partial upgrade state / inconsistent schema versions.
- Customer is compliance-heavy; prefers minimal manual DB intervention.

## Customer environment
- Deployment mode: Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC cluster)
- Control plane: customer-managed
- Data store: customer-managed Postgres (managed service)
- Observability: limited access; Support relies on customer-provided logs + diagnostics bundle.

## What changed
- Customer initiated upgrade from previous installer release to latest available at time of ticket.
- Reported that preflight checks passed, then upgrade stalled at migrations.

## Initial triage notes
- Suspect: long-running migration waiting on lock / blocked by active connections
- Alternate: migration tool deadlock / insufficient privileges / connection pool exhaustion
- Need: installer logs + migration output + DB lock snapshot if available

## Requested from customer (safe artifacts)
Please provide the following (no customer data content required):
1) Installer logs bundle:
   - installer.log (or equivalent)
   - migration runner output (stdout/stderr)
   - timestamps for start of upgrade + when it appeared stuck
2) Cluster events around installer job/pod:
   - kubectl get pods -n redwood-private
   - kubectl describe pod <installer/migrations pod>
   - kubectl logs <installer/migrations pod> --since=2h
3) Control plane version details:
   - current version prior to upgrade
   - target version
   - installer version
4) Postgres connectivity + health (high-level):
   - confirmation Postgres reachable from cluster network
   - any recent DB maintenance

## Workaround / mitigation (validated guidance)
See KB: workaround-private-installer-upgrade-stuck-migrations

### Mitigation checklist (customer-safe)
A) Confirm migrations pod/job is still running and not crash-looping
- If crash-looping: capture logs and do NOT rerun repeatedly (can create noisy partial state)

B) Check for lock contention (if customer DBA can assist)
- Ask DBA to review active sessions + locks during the migration window
- If lock contention is confirmed, pause heavy workloads and retry within the window

C) Controlled retry
- Only after collecting logs and confirming no partial schema corruption
- Support/Platform to guide exact retry steps depending on installer version

## Rollback guidance (if upgrade cannot complete)
Rollback is allowed ONLY if we confirm no irreversible schema migrations have executed.
- Step 1: Collect diagnostics + logs first.
- Step 2: Stop the installer/migrations job to prevent further changes.
- Step 3: Revert control plane deployment manifests to the previous known-good release (customer’s prior pinned artifacts).
- Step 4: Validate control plane health checks + auth + API reachability.
- Step 5: Confirm DB schema version matches the pre-upgrade state.

Do not attempt manual schema downgrades without Platform approval.

## Escalation / ownership
- Primary Eng owner: Platform / Private Deployments (per escalation playbook)
- This ticket is linked to ENG-4828 (add diagnostics bundle + clearer errors for upgrade/migrations failures)

## Next actions
- Support: obtain artifacts above, maintain update cadence with customer during window
- Platform: review logs and advise whether safe rollback is possible
- Engineering follow-up: ensure diagnostics bundle is available + documented (ENG-4828)
comments: 2026-02-06 16:12 UTC — Priya Shah (Support): Opened incident ticket from Helix escalation. Customer reports upgrade stuck at "running migrations" for ~70 minutes. Requested installer logs + pod logs + versions. Created #support bridge thread and pulled in Platform per escalation playbook.

2026-02-06 16:26 UTC — Ethan Park (Platform): Agree likely migration lock contention or runner waiting on DB connection. Please ask for: (1) migration pod logs, (2) Postgres max connections / pooler settings (high-level), (3) whether app traffic continued during maintenance window. Avoid advising manual DB changes until we see output.

2026-02-06 16:43 UTC — Owen Phillips (Support Incidents): Marking P1/Sev1 due to maintenance window blocker + risk of partial state. Starting a small bridge in #support; will move to #incidents if we confirm broader impact (currently single customer).

2026-02-06 17:05 UTC — Customer (Helix, via Support email): Provided installer version + target version; confirmed Postgres reachable and no maintenance today. They can pull pod logs and will share within 30 minutes. They asked if they should cancel/retry the installer now.
2026-02-06 17:10 UTC — Priya Shah (Support): Advised customer to hold off on cancel/retry until logs are collected. Shared a short checklist for safe artifact collection (no data).
2026-02-06 18:02 UTC — Customer: Shared kubectl describe + logs snippet indicating migration step repeatedly printing "waiting for advisory lock" and no progress. No crash-looping observed.

2026-02-06 18:18 UTC — Priya Natarajan (Platform Eng sponsor): "waiting for advisory lock" suggests another session holds lock or previous attempt didn’t release. Ask customer DBA for lock snapshot and any long-lived sessions from prior deployment tooling. If they can safely terminate the locking session, migrations should proceed. If they cannot, we should plan rollback and reschedule upgrade.

2026-02-06 18:40 UTC — Owen Phillips (Support): Drafted rollback decision tree for customer (pending Platform sign-off). Noted we need to confirm whether any schema changes applied before lock wait began; request migration runner output from start of step.

2026-02-07 09:12 UTC — Customer: DBA reviewed and found one long-running session holding advisory lock from previous failed attempt. They terminated that session. Migrations progressed and upgrade completed successfully ~10 minutes later. Control plane health checks green.

2026-02-07 09:30 UTC — Priya Shah (Support): Confirmed resolution with customer; requested they keep logs for 7 days in case of follow-up. Proposed turning this into a Known Issue article section: symptoms + "waiting for advisory lock" explanation + customer-safe lock-check instructions.

2026-02-08 14:05 UTC — Kira Thompson (Docs): Added clearer "When to escalate" + "Do not run manual DB downgrades" language to workaround draft. Request Platform to review lock-contention guidance for customer safety.

2026-02-11 17:22 UTC — Ethan Park (Platform): Signed off on KB wording with minor edits. Asked that we fast-track ENG-4828 so future installs produce a diagnostics bundle automatically (locks + migration phase + last successful step).
resolution: Customer upgrade completed after terminating a stale DB advisory-lock holding session from a prior attempt. Control plane returned to healthy state. Published/updated workaround guidance and linked ENG-4828 to improve diagnostics and error clarity.
